claim.notes: CFR+ (regret matching+, alternating updates, linear averaging) run for 20000 iterations on the game tree in game.json (9451 nodes, 936 infosets). Exploitability is computed by exact best-response traversal of the tree; strategy.json was reloaded and re-checked independently (all infosets present, sums to 1, BR0 -0.0856035, BR1 0.0856093). Per-iteration regret updates are buffered so each infoset uses one strategy per iteration; updating in place slowed convergence to about T^-0.5. Solver is solve_leduc.py in the workspace; run with python3 -I solve_leduc.py.
